response.original_title: Close To Paradise - Zarema And Her Rebel Family
response.overview: The story of Zarema, kidnapped and imprisoned in Chechnya for defending human rights. Each dictator has his own way of intimidating opponents. In Chechnya, Ramzan Kadyrov fights human rights activists by imprisoning someone close to them illegitimately. This is the story of one of these rebel families, based on the letters of Zarema, an innocent mother writing them from prison, and showing the members of her family, split in Europe in a forced exile.
response.title: Close To Paradise - Zarema And Her Rebel Family
